'''Kin Thalin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was the owner of a small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Haven (city)|Haven]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iol]]. Thalin claimed to have discovered a cavern filled with [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]], which had been deposited there by the [[Revanchist]]s shortly after the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="TUR" />
